title: Promote vk23 overlay parity false mismatches into clean audit output
description:
Combined vk23 audit follow-up.

Codex GPT-5.5-max audit found and filed eshyra-jk4d for this issue. This bead exists only if the existing bead was not present in the local Beads database when this script is run; otherwise close or delete this duplicate and use eshyra-jk4d.

Finding:
The bundle's overlay parity report flags four false mismatches for prepared casters:
- cleric data.spellPreparation
- druid data.spellPreparation
- paladin data.spellPreparation
- wizard data.spellPreparation

The actual pack data is richer and source-backed because it includes preparationFormula. The parity report projection drops that field in:
- packages/core/scripts/create-dnd5e-srd-audit-bundle/cli.ts

The source-backed overlay facts include it in:
- packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/creationFacts.ts

This is not a gameplay data blocker, but the thaw standard requires audit output to be clean and non-misleading.

Acceptance criteria:
- Prefer using existing bead eshyra-jk4d if present.
- Update the overlay-vs-pack parity projection to include preparationFormula or otherwise compare equivalent normalized structures.
- Regenerate the audit bundle and confirm overlay-vs-pack-parity reports no false mismatches.
- Keep prepared caster spellPreparation data richer than the overlay oracle where source-backed.
